description: MEDIA BRANCH ONLY — never merged to main. SandboxPilot (github.com/LeanBytes/SandboxPilot) media plan that records MacPacker's marketing videos on the self-hosted Mac mini. main's sandboxpilot.json stays schema 1 and owns the localized App Store screenshots; this file owns the videos. Two cuts of the same story (browse an archive, delete a file from it): a <=12s cut for Reddit and a ~30s tour for YouTube. Both drive the app only through MacPacker's shipping launch parameters (-ArchivePath / -NavigatePath / -SelectItem) plus synthesized clicks — MacPacker carries no automation-only code. Step targets are fractions of the window, measured against MacPacker's default 800x500 pt window (output 1920x1320 = 800x500 + 2x80 pt shadow margin at 2x): file rows sit at y 0.184 / 0.233 / 0.281 / 0.329, the Name column at x 0.12, the toolbar trash at (0.740, 0.053). Changing the output size moves every row fraction. Saving is deliberately not filmed: MacPacker saves via File > Save (Cmd-S) and SandboxPilot's key step has no letter keycodes, so a video can show the edit but not the save.

scenarios.name: reddit-delete
scenarios.description: <=12s: archive open, select hello world.txt, delete it from the zip. One beat — 0.18 turned the viewer into an editor.

scenarios.name: youtube-tour
scenarios.description: ~30s: root list, into folder/, into NestedArchive.zip (a zip inside a zip, browsed like a folder), select two files, back out twice, then delete a file from the archive.
